title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Mercury child grasps a chosen learning object and retains it despite adjacent person-level restlessness
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED_NO_MEANING_CLAIM. The complete cached Md2 Mercury prose270v describes its child as grasping what he wants in learning and retaining it long; the explicit es continues the learning object. The adjacent clauses describe the same person as restless/movable and liking travel. A hypothetical whole account must preserve the learner, chosen learning object, acquisition/grasp and long retention, while keeping person-level mobility separate. The source is a generic capacity/disposition portrait, not an observed completed learning event, a fixed memory test, or a biological/astral causal claim.

design.prediction: A later frozen whole reading claiming this source portrait must jointly distinguish learner from chosen learning object, continue the same object under retention, retain the long duration, and preserve separate person-level restlessness/travel predicates.
